title: File follow-ups for engine gaps and missing projection surfaces
description:
Record a separately owned follow-up for every engine-side gap and missing documentation-projection surface the exhaustive documentation audit uncovered, so none is silently dropped once the audit closes.

## Background

The exhaustive documentation audit fixes documentation drift but explicitly does not fix the engine defects and missing projection surfaces its verification work surfaces — those are out of scope for a docs-only effort. The audit sweeps the adopter-facing documentation in disjoint areas; each sweep cites any volatile fact with no existing projection surface to its source and records it for follow-up rather than building the projection itself. Those recorded facts, plus a known set of engine-side gaps already identified during planning, are this work's input:

- **Generated CLI schema completeness.** The schema's `State` enum is missing the `rejected` value (compare the hardcoded list in `crates/jit/src/schema.rs:463-469` against the real 7-value enum in `crates/jit/src/domain/types.rs:28-42`). Separately, clap `visible_alias` flag forms and the global flags are absent from the schema's flag listing (e.g. `--add-label`, `crates/jit/src/cli.rs:986`; `--title`, `cli.rs:1827`) — fixing this is also what makes a committed schema-vs-docs flag differ trivial to add later, rather than leaving flag adjudication a judgment call in every future doc audit.
- **Missing projection surfaces for storage specifics** — the ID scheme, event shape, and gate-runs layout currently have no projection surface and must be cited to source in documentation rather than hand-copied.
- **The CLI's issue-creation `--description` flag help string** describes the content format rather than describing the flag itself (`crates/jit/src/cli.rs`) — a CLI polish defect outside docs scope.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each known engine-side gap named above has a separately owned follow-up describing its source location and the correction it defers.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every missing-projection-surface fact recorded during the audit's area sweeps has a separately owned follow-up covering it; none is dropped.

## Notes

No documentation or source files change as part of this work; the deliverable is the recorded follow-ups themselves.
